FROZEN_RULES.primary_decision_rule: PASS if and only if the whole 90 % interval lies inside the margin. A point estimate near zero does not qualify. Excluding H_linear does not qualify. Excluding H_sublinear does not qualify.
FROZEN_RULES.stringent_field: primary_endpoint.stringent_reference_margin = 0.042, status: reported, never decisive. Its power at the frozen sample size is 0.314, and reaching 90 % would need about 200 arms per size, roughly 10.1 hours of engine time, far beyond the declared budget cap of 49 arms per size. It is therefore PRE-DECLARED UNDERPOWERED before any run.
FROZEN_RULES.global_qualification_rule: the global qualification requires BOTH the population support gate AND the conditional equivalence test
FROZEN_RULES.stopping_rule: every frozen arm is run. No interim analysis may raise or lower the budget, replace a seed, move a margin, change the model, change the extinction treatment or open a fourth domain size.
FROZEN_RULES.WHAT_IS_FROZEN_INSTEAD: a list of nine names, plus TWO binding rules: the primary decision rule, and the global qualification rule requiring BOTH the population support gate AND the conditional equivalence test

under_margin_0.25.why_was_equivalence_not_declared_in_OBDI: it WAS declared by the frozen gate: OBDI02/out/_results.json records PRIMARY.PASS = true. The final disposition was then chosen by OBDI02/code/analysis_obdi02.py, a POST_RUN file at rank 7 of the hierarchy, which added a further condition — the interval had to lie inside [-0.042, +0.042] — that the frozen protocol had explicitly declared 'reported, never decisive'.

under_margin_0.042.would_the_taxonomy_allow_NOT_ESTABLISHED: only if the estimate were compatible with zero AND there were no positive evidence of growth. At the 90 % level used by the frozen test the interval excludes zero, so under a binding 0.042 the honest reading would be closer to DOMAIN_SIZE_INVARIANCE_FAIL than to NOT_ESTABLISHED. This is hypothetical: 0.042 is NOT the binding margin.

underpower_rule.the_frozen_stopping_rule_says: every frozen arm is run. No interim analysis may raise or lower the budget, replace a seed, move a margin, change the model, change the extinction treatment or open a fourth domain size.
underpower_rule.VERDICT: NO VIOLATION. The underpower stop applies to the BINDING primary. At the binding margin 0.25 the required n was 10 and 46 were run, so the design was over-powered, not under-powered, for the test that actually governed. The 0.042 figure was frozen as a non-decisive reference with its insufficient power stated in advance.

CONFORMITY_OF_THE_OBDI02_DISPOSITION.WHAT_THE_FREEZE_SAYS_ABOUT_THAT_FIGURE: reported, never decisive. Its power at the frozen sample size is 0.314, and reaching 90 % would need about 200 arms per size, roughly 10.1 hours of engine time, far beyond the declared budget cap of 49 arms per size. It is therefore PRE-DECLARED UNDERPOWERED before any run.
CONFORMITY_OF_THE_OBDI02_DISPOSITION.EXPLANATION: the frozen protocol binds the primary decision to equivalence_margin = 0.25 and binds the global qualification to the conjunction of the support gate and the conditional equivalence test. Both were satisfied. The reported disposition was produced by adding, after the results were open, a condition the freeze had explicitly stripped of decisiveness. Under the hierarchy of §3 a rank-7 file cannot do that.
CONFORMITY_OF_THE_OBDI02_DISPOSITION.SEVERITY: this is a PROTOCOL VIOLATION in the conservative direction: it withheld a qualification the freeze granted. It did not manufacture a result, move a threshold in the permissive direction, drop an arm or replace a seed. It is nevertheless a violation and is recorded as one.

low_population_not_extinct.rule: N_X_mean below half the per-size median of the surviving arms (post-hoc, diagnostic, never applied)

ARM_MATRIX_SUMMARY.weight_in_the_regression: the frozen estimator weights a SIZE, not an arm: w_L = n_L / sd_L(log summary)^2. A single extreme arm therefore acts twice — it moves the size mean and it inflates that size's sd, which lowers its weight. The net influence is measured by leave-one-out below rather than argued.

3_the_effect_must_not_be_read_as_physica.reason: under a mechanism with NO domain effect whatsoever, injecting only the observed population distributions produces a coefficient at least as large as the observed one with probability 0.357. The observed value is therefore TYPICAL of a pure measurement artefact and cannot be attributed to the domain.

ESTIMAND_ADJUDICATION.HONEST_CAVEAT: the confound is not unique to |C - Y|: the guard-rail statistics are population sensitive too (corr(log N_X, log R_g) = -0.600, log r80 = -0.587, profile TV = -0.881 against -0.846 for the primary metric). What separates them is that their observed coefficients are already indistinguishable from zero, so no artefact needs to be invoked to explain them, whereas the primary coefficient is entirely explained by one.

r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).alignment_with_attachment: HIGH: it is the radius of the cloud measured FROM the organiser, so it answers 'how far from the source is the mass' without estimating a centre at all
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).low_population_bias: MEASURED AND WORSE THAN EXPECTED: on real fields the source-centred 80 % quantile drifts by 12.6 % between N = 115 and N = 3, and its correlation with log N_X is -0.870, slightly STRONGER than the primary metric's -0.846. Avoiding the centre estimation is not sufficient: a quantile of N distances is itself biased at small N.
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).variance: measured: se(beta) = 0.01728 on these very data
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).behaviour_under_extinction: undefined when N_X = 0, same as any spatial statistic
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).invariance_under_the_null: to be established by the same population null before any use
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).parameter_free_prediction: YES: the operator's exact relative profile gives r80_Y with no fitted constant
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).auditability: HIGH: already recorded per frame in every archive of the chain
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).compatible_with_recorded_data: YES, recomputable on all 138 arms and on OBDI01
r80_Y (source-centred 80 % radius).needs_new_simulations: NO for the estimate; YES for a pre-registered null

mean per-particle d_T(X_i, Y)^2.low_population_bias: STRUCTURALLY NONE: it is an ordinary mean over particles, so its expectation is independent of how many particles are drawn. Verified by raw-only downsampling on 24 real fields: the ratio to the full-sample value stays within 1.6 % of one down to N = 3, against 12.6 % for r80_Y and 56.6 % for |C - Y|.
mean per-particle d_T(X_i, Y)^2.parameter_free_prediction: YES, the operator gives the second moment exactly
mean per-particle d_T(X_i, Y)^2.auditability: MEDIUM: not currently recorded per frame, but recomputable from the final field only, not from the whole window
mean per-particle d_T(X_i, Y)^2.needs_new_simulations: NO for the law, but the window statistic is not recorded
mean per-particle d_T(X_i, Y)^2.variance: higher than a quantile in the tail, because it is a second moment; this is the price of unbiasedness and must be paid in the sample size, not hidden
mean per-particle d_T(X_i, Y)^2.invariance_under_the_null: must still be established by the same population null before any confirmatory use

normalised likelihood under the N2 profi.low_population_bias: LOW: the likelihood already accounts for the sample size

latent displacement by maximum likelihoo.alignment_with_attachment: HIGHEST: it estimates the quantity |C* - Y| itself and reports its own uncertainty
latent displacement by maximum likelihoo.auditability: LOW: the most machinery, the most assumptions

finite-N corrected centre.low_population_bias: corrected to first order only; the correction is exact for the empirical mean and only approximate for the Frechet centre on a torus

ALTERNATIVE_ESTIMANDS.SELECTION_REASON: it is the only candidate whose freedom from population bias is STRUCTURAL rather than empirical — the expectation of a mean does not depend on the sample size — and the raw-only downsampling confirms it holds on real fields down to three molecules. The operator supplies its second moment exactly, so a parameter-free prediction exists. Its cost is that the window statistic is not recorded in the existing archives: it is computable on the final field of every arm but not on the whole window, so a future mission would have to record it. NO confirmatory threshold is chosen here.

RAW_ONLY_COMPARISON.READING: the mean per-particle squared distance to the source is an ORDINARY MEAN over particles: its expectation does not depend on how many particles are drawn, and the downsampling confirms it — the ratio stays within 1.6 % of one down to N = 3, while the source-centred 80 % quantile drifts by 12.6 % and the Frechet-centre offset by 56.6 %.

WHY_NOT_THE_OTHERS.ATTACHMENT_ESTIMAND_POPULATION_CONFOUNDE: the primary metric is indeed not physically adjudicable, but this disposition would also withhold the qualification the frozen protocol grants on the size and profile axes, which are supported by the same 138 arms and whose coefficients are flat to about one percent
WHY_NOT_THE_OTHERS.OBDI02_BINDING_STRICT_TARGET_FAIL: 0.042 is not the binding margin: §5 verdict C
WHY_NOT_THE_OTHERS.OBDI02_AUDIT_INVALID__UNDERPOWERED_BINDI: the binding gate at 0.25 required n = 10 and 46 were run; no frozen rule forbade execution
WHY_NOT_THE_OTHERS.FROZEN_PROTOCOL_CONFLICT: there is no conflict inside the freeze: one field is the margin, another is a reference explicitly marked non-decisive

Under the hierarchy of §3 a rank-7 file cannot do that.
